# StudyLib

> A collaborative document-sharing and learning platform offering study collections, educational resources, and reference materials across diverse academic and professional disciplines.

StudyLib aggregates user-created and curated study materials spanning languages, engineering, healthcare, business, and sciences. The platform emphasizes collaborative learning through organized collections and comprehensive educational resources for students and professionals.

## Engineering & Technical Reference

- [Shigley's Mechanical Engineering Design](https://studylib.net/c/99442): Shigley's Mechanical Engineering Design textbook and reference material
- [Automotive Engineering Systems](https://studylib.net/c/75402): Automotive engineering vehicle systems and technical learning material
- [Biomechanics Stability Principles](https://studylib.net/c/38417): Biomechanics stability principles and center of gravity study guide
- [Technical Indicators Study Collection](https://studylib.net/c/63482): Technical indicators study collection for collaborative learning platform

## Medical & Healthcare Reference

- [Pollen Cross Reactivities](https://studylib.net/c/99505): Allergen immunotherapy medical reference on pollen cross-reactivity
- [Esthetician Professional Development](https://studylib.net/c/99533): Facial manipulation techniques guide for esthetician professional development
- [Manual Handling Safety Assessment](https://studylib.net/c/38462): Manual handling risk assessment checklist and safety standards

## Language Learning & Exams

- [B1 Preliminary English Exam Practice](https://studylib.net/c/99494): B1 Preliminary English exam practice tests and learning resources
- [Business Benchmark Upper Intermediate English](https://studylib.net/c/99443): Business Benchmark Upper Intermediate English learning materials

## Business & Economics

- [Managing Fashion & Luxury Companies](https://studylib.net/c/99521): Fashion & luxury business strategies study collection with Corbellini & Saviolo
- [Supply and Demand Economics](https://studylib.net/c/103428): Supply and demand economics trading study collection

## Science & General Education

- [Science of Cooking](https://studylib.net/c/103370): Science of cooking biology and chemistry of food study collection
- [World Climate Zones Geography](https://studylib.net/c/63438): World climate zones geography worksheet and educational activity
- [Cambridge IGCSE Music Resources](https://studylib.net/c/51462): Cambridge IGCSE Music scheme of work and educational resources
- [Parental Licensing Ethics](https://studylib.net/c/103371): Parental licensing ethics rights and public welfare study material
